scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run dev -w @roniella/backend" "npm run dev -w @roniella/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @roniella/shared && npm run build -w @roniella/backend && npm run build -w @roniella/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web "npm run start -w @roniella/backend" "npm run start -w @roniella/frontend"
scripts.build:vercel:web: npm run build -w @roniella/shared && npm run build -w @roniella/frontend && node scripts/build-vercel.mjs frontend
scripts.build:vercel:api: npm run build -w @roniella/shared && node scripts/build-vercel.mjs backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:vercel:api && npm run build:vercel:web
scripts.check:deployment: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:verify && npm run build && npm run test:deployment
scripts.check:vercel: npm run check:deployment && npm run build:vercel && npm run test:vercel
